g.text: C Additional coarsening to the authors' broad tissue decoder
Each branch ID is replaced by the decoder's third-column tissue label, giving a coarser 24-label graph.
24 nodes | 30 non-self edges | 6 nodes with 2+ children | longest DAG path: 6
These are broad branch-level tissue labels, not the 49 finer per-state annotations. Unknown branches are merged without biological curation.
Arrows are direct non-self projected links. Reachability must be projected from the branch graph before any additional closure.
Its apparent 6-edge depth includes concatenations of different branches and does not establish a 6-decision biological lineage.
Source: Calderon et al. (2022), released celltype_list_rna.txt and RNA lineage table. Preliminary reconstruction.
